Protein Food

Button Mushroom

About This Entry

Button mushroom is the young white Agaricus — salads, pizzas, and pan sauces. Mild umami pairs with Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and sparkling.

Beginner Guide

Youngest form of Agaricus bisporus; same species as cremini and portobello.

FAQ

What is Button Mushroom?
Youngest form of Agaricus bisporus; same species as cremini and portobello.
How should Button Mushroom be prepared for pairing-friendly dishes?
High-heat sear or roast develops umami; avoid waterlogged cooking. Wine pairing follows butter, garlic, and sauce context.
